expected: Wrong/missing key refused on generation routes; dead endpoint fails; auxiliary routing and test egress controls evidenced.
limitations: The guard is environment-based (proxy variables), not enforcement; a process that ignores proxy variables can still reach the network. No firewall rule was added.
The ETW observation covers the processes and turns traced, not all possible tool behavior.
observed: All 9 protected GET routes (now including /status, authenticated since Strata v0.1.28) and 3 POST routes answer 401 without a key, with a wrong Bearer key and with a wrong x-api-key, and 200 with the key; only /health and / are public; shared settings unchanged. The launcher refuses a missing, empty and blank key before OMP starts. OMP with a wrong key exits 1 with zero engine requests; OMP against a dead loopback port exits 1 after 32 s of its own retries (no reroute). Route census over every session so far: provider strata-local, one model, API openai-completions. ETW Kernel-Network trace over a typed tool turn plus a turn that forced OMP compaction (1 compaction): 3559 events attributed to the OMP and Strata process trees, 0 to non-loopback endpoints; loopback probes of ports 11434, 8080 and 1234 (OMP's implicit local providers) remain.
